title.narrative: Emergency Locust Response in Tigray, Ethiopia

description.narrative: UNOPS helps fight locust swarms that are threatening food security and livelihoods of farmers. In addition to the immediate measures aimed at curtailing the spread of Desert Locusts, it is critical to help to prevent and respond to the threat posed by desert locust outbreak infestation and strengthen national systems for preparedness in the target areas in the Tigray region.
